first_launch.alt: Character Card Forge Home screen with the main navigation and recent projects
first_launch.caption: The Home screen keeps creation, Library, Help Center and support tools within the main navigation.

first_character.alt: New Project chooser with creation routes, template selection and Create Project button
first_character.caption: Choose a creation route and template, then confirm with Create Project.

manual_editing.alt: Character Workspace showing the primary editing tabs and populated character fields
manual_editing.caption: The Workspace keeps canonical character fields and task-specific tools in one project view.

character_builder.alt: Character Builder with editable Foundation fields and AI-assisted actions
character_builder.caption: Character Builder supports manual answers, AI suggestions and reviewable application to the character.

idea_generator_notebook.alt: Idea Generator with a concept prompt, detail selector and generated character idea
idea_generator_notebook.caption: Idea Generator turns configurable ingredients into reviewable concepts.

idea_generator_notebook.alt: Idea Notebook with saved ideas and the selected idea details
idea_generator_notebook.caption: Idea Notebook stores promising concepts independently from Character Projects.

character_collaborator.alt: Character Collaborator conversation with source controls and generation actions
character_collaborator.caption: Character Collaborator keeps the target, reference sources and generated handoff explicit.

templates_generation_modes.alt: Structured Builder showing configurable character ingredients and lock controls
templates_generation_modes.caption: Structured creation modes let you configure and lock ingredients before generation.

workspace_quality.alt: Populated Character Workspace with editing tabs and quality tools
workspace_quality.caption: Use the Workspace as the canonical editing surface before inspection, review and export.

greetings_scenarios.alt: Character Workspace with the Scenario Presets and Alternative Greetings tools
greetings_scenarios.caption: Scenario Presets and Alternative Greetings provide reviewable alternate openings without replacing the canonical card silently.

lorebooks_relationships.alt: Lorebook Manager with named entries, trigger keys, lore content and Trigger Preview
lorebooks_relationships.caption: Named lore entries combine editable content with explicit activation keys and trigger testing.

card_inspector.alt: Card Inspector showing token estimates, health checks and card metadata
card_inspector.caption: Card Inspector provides deterministic health, token and interchange information before AI review or export.

ai_review.alt: AI Review window showing the score, rubric and review report controls
ai_review.caption: AI Review is advisory and keeps the complete report and proposed changes visible before application.

revision_history.alt: Revision History comparison showing selectable revisions and field-level differences
revision_history.caption: Revision History compares saved states and supports selective, non-destructive recovery.

library_basics.alt: Character Library with search, filters, scalable card grid and project details
library_basics.caption: The Library combines indexed search, workflow filters, privacy presentation and scalable cards.

library_layout.alt: Character Library showing card density and collapsible side panels
library_layout.caption: Adjust card density and collapse either side panel to prioritise the grid or project details.

multi_projects.alt: Multi-Character Workspace showing a roster and combined workflow draft
multi_projects.caption: Multi-character projects separate the persistent roster from the active cast and combined output.

image_studio.alt: Image Studio with prompt controls, reference inputs and managed results
image_studio.caption: Image Studio keeps creative intent, provider execution settings, source images and accepted results distinct.

image_inputs.alt: Image Studio Inputs tab with image-to-image, reference and inpainting controls
image_inputs.caption: Reference, image-to-image and inpainting inputs remain explicit and operation-specific.

avatar_expressions.alt: Avatar Gallery and Expression Set workflow with labelled generated images
avatar_expressions.caption: Accepted alternate looks and exact expression labels share the managed Avatar Gallery.

import_character.alt: Character import preview with portrait, detected format, validation and import choices
import_character.caption: Import preview identifies the format, validates the card and presents explicit import choices before writing a project.

export_character.alt: Export and Front Porch window showing the Direct Front Porch Install workflow
export_character.caption: Export and installation actions show their target, validation state and result instead of writing silently.

front_porch.alt: Direct Front Porch Install screen with connection and active-character status
front_porch.caption: Front Porch integration uses explicit supported-API connection, validation and install actions.

front_porch_install_sync.alt: Front Porch install and synchronization screen showing connection and card readiness
front_porch_install_sync.caption: Connection, card readiness and supported install or synchronization actions remain visible to the author.
